headline: Guinea's Simandou Iron Ore Project Ships First Cargo to Europe
summary: Guinea's giant Simandou iron ore project has shipped its first cargo to Europe, breaking China's primary export grip on the massive mining development.
why: Simandou is the world's largest untapped iron ore deposit; diversifying export destinations alters global steel raw material supply chains and trade flows.

impacts.name: Iron Ore
impacts.why: New export routes from mega-deposits change regional supply availability for European steelmakers.
